title: Diamond trail datapack
description: A data pack that creates a diamond block trail and an emerald particle trail when holding a diamond block in your main hand, this also works in the air.
body:
# Diamond trail datapack
This datapack adds super fun trails when holding a diamond block!
## Features
- Easy to use
- Works properly, Unlike When you try to make a command block with the same command, but it works smoothly on a datapack because it refreshes every tick
- The most important one! It adds a diamond block trail and an emerald particle trail when holding a diamond block 
- Very fun!
## Notes
This datapack only changes mechanics meaning you can safely add this to an existing world!
